run_linter_on_workflow_files: run the linter on one or more GitHub Actions workflow YAML files to check for fork safety
check_file_for_fork_safety: check a single GitHub Actions workflow file to ensure jobs guard against running on forks
load_yaml_safe: load and parse a YAML file using the safe CSafeLoader or SafeLoader fallback
gen_lint_message: generate a LintMessage with code NO_WORKFLOWS_ON_FORK for a given filename and description
review_LintSeverity: review the LintSeverity enum which defines ERROR, WARNING, ADVICE, and DISABLED severity levels
